projects.title: Yeneschool
projects.summary: A complete school administration platform handling students, staff, academics, and finances in one place.

sections.heading: The Challenge
paragraphs: Schools juggle a dozen disconnected tools—attendance books, grade sheets, fee ledgers, and parent communication. Managing this manually is slow, error-prone, and scales poorly as the school grows.

sections.heading: The Solution
paragraphs: I built a unified school management system that brings student records, staff management, class scheduling, attendance tracking, grading, and fee management into a single, easy-to-use dashboard.

sections.heading: Key Features
paragraphs: Student and staff profile management, academic records with grade tracking, fee and payment management, role-based access for admins, teachers, and staff, and responsive design for use on any device.

sections.heading: Impact
paragraphs: The system removes hours of manual administrative work each week, centralizes data in one reliable place, and gives school leaders real-time insight into attendance, grades, and finances.

projects.title: Fenaid
projects.summary: A unified coordination platform connecting families of children with intellectual and physical disabilities to essential care, therapy, and support services.

sections.heading: The Challenge
paragraphs: Families caring for children with specialized physical and developmental needs frequently struggle with fragmented services, scattered medical paperwork, and prolonged referral delays without clear care milestones.

sections.heading: The Solution
paragraphs: I built a centralized platform enabling care coordinators, therapists, and families to discover specialized programs, book sessions, and collaboratively monitor developmental progress in one accessible portal.

sections.heading: Key Features
paragraphs: Verified disability resource directory, integrated appointment scheduling, milestone & progress tracking for children, and accessible, role-based interfaces tailored for families and service providers.

sections.heading: Impact
paragraphs: Significantly simplified how families discover qualified care and equipped providers with clear caseload visibility to track longitudinal therapy outcomes.

projects.title: Mykeycoffe
projects.summary: A curated digital marketplace celebrating Arabian coffee heritage, connecting artisanal roasters with coffee enthusiasts through an intuitive ordering experience.

sections.heading: The Challenge
paragraphs: Specialty coffee roasters and regional consumers lacked a dedicated digital hub tailored to the nuanced roasting profiles, origins, and brewing techniques of Arabian coffee culture.

sections.heading: The Solution
paragraphs: Developed an end-to-end e-commerce platform featuring origin and roast breakdowns, roaster profiles, tailored brew recommendations, and an efficient shopping workflow.

sections.heading: Key Features
paragraphs: Roast and origin categorization (espresso, filter, cold brew, beans), roaster storefronts with seasonal releases, fast search and filtration, cart management, and mobile-first checkout.

sections.heading: Impact
paragraphs: Created an engaging bridge between artisanal roasters and coffee lovers, fostering higher product discovery and community appreciation for regional coffee craft.

projects.title: Saftex Garment
projects.summary: A distributed multi-branch inventory management system engineered for garment manufacturers, retail branches, and uniform fulfillment.

sections.heading: The Challenge
paragraphs: Garment businesses operating across multiple branch locations struggle with manual spreadsheets, recurring stock discrepancies, misplaced uniform orders, and delayed restocks.

sections.heading: The Solution
paragraphs: Architected a centralized inventory system with real-time multi-branch stock tracking, batch uniform allocation, inter-branch transfers, and automated low-stock triggers.

sections.heading: Key Features
paragraphs: Multi-location stock synchronization, uniform sizing matrix and batch tracking, automated reorder thresholds, audit trails for transfer slips, and tiered branch manager permissions.

sections.heading: Impact
paragraphs: Eliminated manual cross-branch auditing, drastically minimized stockout rates, and provided leadership with instant visibility into warehouse valuation across all branches.
